changelog: Makes a series switched off from the plugin's own configuration page take effect. The excluded-series set is cached in memory because it is read for every row entry, and it was only ever rebuilt when the toggle itself changed it - a save from the dashboard hands back a whole new configuration object, which the cache had no way of noticing, so those exclusions were stored but never applied until the next restart. It now rebuilds whenever the configuration object it was built from has been replaced.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
